brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: One editorial basketball article thumbnail for バスケまとめ.
Primary request: Generate exactly one finished PNG illustration, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 pixels (at least 1000px wide), with crisp accurate Japanese typography. This is an original illustrated imagined basketball action, not a photograph, not a reconstruction of any actual game.

Visual references already inspected in this conversation:
1. Approved B-culver-black-lime-v3.png: style reference ONLY. Match the dark charcoal #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory, bold Japanese headline, expressive hand-drawn ink and dry-brush strokes. Do NOT copy any player, name, scoring statistic, date or score from that style reference.
2. The official B.LEAGUE portrait of real player Kanji Takahira / 髙比良寛治, https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/2488/2026-27/12605_03.png: facial likeness reference ONLY. He is the sole illustrated person. Preserve his recognizable short undercut: closely clipped dark sides, short textured light brown/blond highlighted top swept to his right; broad angular/oval face, strong slightly square jaw, dark straight eyebrows, narrow almond-shaped eyes, wide rounded nose, clean-shaven cheeks and chin, athletic stocky shoulders. Translate these specific features into expressive ink illustration. Do not depict a generic fictional athlete. Do not paste, trace or composite the official photo, do not reproduce its jersey logos or photo pose.

Composition: Place Takahira on the LEFT 43% in a dynamic low crossover dribbling stance, three-quarter view facing toward the right. His right palm is controlling the upper side of one orange basketball near hip/thigh height, five anatomically correct fingers; his free left hand is relaxed and naturally open. Head, face, both hands and ball stay entirely inside the canvas with generous margins; figure framed from head to bent knees, shorts may naturally exit near the lower-left edge. Strong movement in torso and shoulders, focused expression. Plain dark sleeveless basketball kit with ivory edge trim, no numbers, no names, no team marks, no sponsor marks. Black and ivory ink for skin and body, warm light brown highlight for hair; lime gestural accents. Minimal abstract brush backdrop, no literal arena, opponent, scoreboard, hoop or depicted match.

Typography: RIGHT 57% clean readable text zone with ample negative space, no overlap with face, hands or ball. Large extra-bold Japanese sans-serif. Main headline split in two stacked lines: enormous lime '11/24', then enormous ivory '試合なし'. Small ivory site title at top. The three category names on one smaller readable line below headline. Beneath this, a smaller clearly readable source-time qualifier. Footer spans safe area and contains both the AI label and image disclaimer, unobscured, with sufficient contrast. Allow 5% safe margin around all text.

Text (verbatim, each exactly once, no other text):
バスケまとめ
11/24
試合なし
B.PREMIER・B.ONE・B.NEXT
2026年11月24日 08:10 JST時点
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

Source context: the ONLY article facts are from the supplied fixed source.html and source.txt: no games on 2026-11-24 in B.PREMIER, B.ONE and B.NEXT; data obtained at 08:10 JST that day. The player was randomly selected because the article contains no player or team names. Do not imply he played, won, scored or was scheduled that day. Do not put his name, number, team or any individual performance in the image. The words イメージ and イラスト（AI生成） must be visible. No league or team logos, no sponsor names, no official photos, no photorealism, no unrelated copy. Use few graphic elements and sharp high-impact thumbnail readability.

visual_qa_notes.text_and_numbers: 全7行を画像で読み、11/24、2026年11月24日、08:10、3カテゴリー名の表記を固定原稿と照合。選手の氏名・成績なし。
